पूछकर देखें: *जयपुर ज़िले में भूजल की स्थिति क्या है?* या *Semi-critical का मतलब क्या है?*

**JalMitra** groundwater, mitti, paani ki quality, fasal aur zameen ke liye ek local, multilingual jaankari sahayak hai. Yeh is app mein rakhe official aur published datasets padhta hai aur unhe aasaan bhasha mein samjhata hai. Yeh isi computer par chalta hai aur kisi online AI service ka use nahi karta.

**Aap yahan kya kar sakte hain:**
- **Groundwater:** poore Bharat ki 6,762 assessment units ki 2025 ki official category (Safe, Semi-critical, Critical, Over-exploited, Saline), aur Rajasthan ke 302 blocks ke detailed figures (recharge, extraction, stage of extraction). Jagahon ki tulna aur district/state summary bhi dekh sakte hain.
- **Soil Health:** apna Soil Health Card ya lab report (PDF, CSV ya Excel) upload kijiye, values check kijiye, aur har parameter ka matlab published reference ranges ke saath samajhiye.
- **Water Quality:** apne paani ki jaanch ke results ko BIS IS 10500 peene ke paani ki limits aur IS 11624 sinchai guidelines se milaiye. JalMitra paani ko peene ke liye safe declare nahi karta; yeh sirf accredited lab kar sakti hai.
- **Crops aur Irrigation:** fasal ki paani ki zaroorat aur salt tolerance jaisi jaankari (FAO, SKNAU Zone II-A) aur sinchai ke tareekon par guidance.
- **Land Information:** Land Condition Report, jismein kisi jagah ka uplabdh data ek saath milta hai.
- **Reports:** 6 download hone wali reports: groundwater, soil, land, crop, irrigation aur complete report.
- **Languages:** English, Hindi, Hinglish, Rajasthani, Punjabi aur Marathi.

**Zaroori:** jawab is app mein load kiye gaye datasets par depend karte hain. Har jagah ka coverage ek jaisa nahi hai. Jab koi value nahi hoti, JalMitra andaza lagane ke bajay "Not available in the current dataset" batata hai.
